question:
A 25-year-old woman sustains an eye injury during a racquetball game when her opponent's racquet
slips from their grip and strikes her eye. Upon examination, a minor corneal abrasion is identified.
Which of the following represents the most appropriate initial treatment? Answer Choices: (A)
Combination antibiotic-steroid ointment (B) Erythromycin ointment (C) Placement of an eye patch (D)
Cycloplegic drops (E) Observation without intervention (F) NSAID eye drops (G) Bland lubricating
ointment for 6-8 weeks (H) Oral antibiotics (I) Topical corticosteroids (J) Saline irrigation only
 A. Saline irrigation only
B. Observation without intervention
C. Erythromycin ointment
D. Oral antibiotics
E. Placement of an eye patch
F. Topical corticosteroids
G. Cycloplegic drops
H. NSAID eye drops
I. Combination antibiotic-steroid ointment
J. Bland lubricating ointment for 6-8 weeks
